info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: dantyozmAntaH . ' hiMsAyAM Sasati ' ( Slo. 184) iti devaH . ' vaDe ' iti vopadevaH .

examples: 'avaSasA niHSasA parASasopArima' (aTarva॰6.45.2). parASasA=parANmuKahiMsanena. upArimeti liwyuttamabahuvacane rUpam.
'avaSasA niHSasA yatparASasopArima jAgrato yatsvapantaH' (aTarva0 6.45.2). avaSasA avastAd hiMsanena. avapUrvAcCaseH kvip.
'anumantA viSasitA nihantA krayavikrayI' (manu0 5.51). viSasitA'NgAni yaH kartaryAdinA pfTak karoti.
'tasyAstvaM duhitustaTA viSasanaM kiM dAruRe'mfzyaTAH' (uttara0 4.5). viSasanaM kadanaM nibarhaRam.
'SoRitodAM raTAvartAM kftvA viSasane nadIm' (BA0 droRa0 16.43). viSasanaM saNgaraH, yudDaBUH.
'DfziSasI vEyAtye' (PA0 7.2.19). vEyAtye DArzwye'vinaye viSasta iti Bavati, anyatra viSasitaH.
'mAM vA hareyustvadDastAd viSaseyuraTApi vA.' viSaseyuH=hiMsyuH. anyatra viSasanaM vikartanaM Bavati.
'yadASasA vadato me vicukzuBe' (aTarva0 7.59.1). ASasA dAtfBiH kftena yAcYAnApratiGAtena BartsanapraharaRAdirUpeRa hiMsanena (sAyaRaH).
